note: Fails three of five, including both economic criteria outright. He was let go from the job he relocated to Austin for, has no business, no clients and no income from the coaching certification he is mid-way through, and stated his position without ambiguity: 'currently unemployed, coming out of pocket, don't have any credit to put it on, don't have anybody to borrow from.' A live credit application confirmed it. Good-to-great fails too — this is recovery from a two-year decline he dates to leaving Chicago, the rebuilder's position rather than the optimiser's. What he does meet is neglected health, comprehensively, and he is not the excluded deconditioned profile: 170 lb, a long calisthenics background and no aversion to training, only to doing it alone. The finding for the rollup is a qualification one rather than a judgement one: he told the setter the day before that he had lost his job and that payment-plan digestibility was his constraint, and he was booked into a $6,000 closing call regardless. An ICP screen that runs before the closer's calendar rather than during it would have caught this.
